title: galium californicum subsp. miguelense
intro: Galium californicum subsp. miguelense, commonly known as California bedstraw, is a subspecies of the Galium californicum plant, which is a flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which may aid in relieving pain and muscle cramps. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax the muscles, reduce anxiety, and promote a good night's sleep. The bioactive constituents of Galium californicum subsp. miguelense include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
